email.subject: Quick note on Harbor Co Auto Care's website
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I took a look at Harbor Co Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next shop, and the homepage title doesn't say "auto repair" or "Harbor Falls," which hurts how you show up in Google searches.

Both are fixable without a redesign. I run a one-person shop fixing exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what I'd change and why. No pitch if it's not a fit.

Alex
